Name: Timer Machine
Author: Farnuk
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/R5I559e.png[/img]

I always wanted to put lots of sheds down on my farm and have big days where I earn lots of that juicy gold but i always found myself forgetting to check on them. I tried the lifehack of putting the same machines and things outside to show when your items were done but that didnt work for everything so i thought.... why not make something that DOES work for everything! 

THE TIMER MACHINE WOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
[color=#000000]

[size=1][b][u]Future update plans:
[/u][/b]
Create craftable items
one craftable for each day with a check mark sprite
Add sign functionality[/size][/color]
﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/bIhleED.png[/img]
[b][u]To use this mod you must:
[/u][/b]
Go to Pierres shop and purchase the machine for 500g.
Place it where you wish
Add one item to start a day timer
Stone: 1 Day
Fiber: 2 Days
Wood: 3 Days
Hardwood: 4 Days
Copper ore: 7 Days
Iron Ore: 14 Days
Gold ore: 28 days.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SbQgmW0.png[/img]
[url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
Download this mod and unzip it.
Put it into Stardew valley/mods
Run the game using SMAPI.
